answers.core: Don't think it's possible as a add-on
answers.workaround:
Whenever you want to change a project setting that isn't in basic mode, you can:
- Activate advanced mode
- Find the setting and change it
- Disable advanced mode

When doing this for every new project (in the case of `editor/node_naming`), or often (`editor/run/main_run_args`), this easily becomes a hassle.

title: Editor setting for adding project settings to basic mode
